name: openvino-dsh-plugin
description: OpenVINO / Intel GPU toolkit plugin for DeepSeek Harness. One-click environment diagnostics (CPU/GPU/NPU devices, openvino_genai versions, OVMS status), local model directory scanning, unified OVMS-registered vs installed vs running status judgement, benchmark (openvino_benchmark.py wrapper), and HF→OpenVINO INT4 conversion with the correct quantization posture (NNCF via optimum-cli --weight-format int4) plus artifact verification.
